patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with a consistent maximum width for text and interactive elements, centered on the page.
Section titles often use a smaller, uppercase, bold sans-serif font, contrasting with the very large, bold sans-serif headlines for primary messaging.
The design primarily uses a high-contrast black and white palette, with a dark gray for secondary text and a bright yellow for a top announcement banner and subtle accents.
The top announcement banner slides out of view on scroll, while the main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
The site heavily integrates rich media, featuring a prominent video hero and multiple sections showcasing interactive 3D models and product videos.

technique_notes: The top announcement bar is designed to disappear with a simple scroll-triggered animation, likely by animating its height or transform property to zero.
The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, fixed to the top of the viewport after the initial scroll.

The hero section features a background video that appears to auto-play muted, with an 'Unmute' button that becomes visible or active as the user scrolls into or past the initial hero view, allowing user control over audio.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif hero headlines (~4-5x body text) are paired with smaller, uppercase, bold labels for section titles and clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied consistently to buttons, cards, and image/video containers, providing a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy density, with generous vertical spacing in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: This site's design stands out by effectively using its own product—interactive 3D models and video—as core design elements throughout the page. The clean, high-contrast aesthetic ensures the rich media content remains the focal point, making the site a direct demonstration of its capabilities rather than just a description.
